name: Stinky's Escape
summary: In the swamp, “Stinky” Ignatz is trapped by critters before he finds bogbean. Mebok Mizzyrix of Ratchet needs the leaves for a potion, so Ignatz asks you to free and guard him as he searches. Then find Mebok in Ratchet.

sections.title: Surrounded in the Swamp
sections.body: “Stinky” Ignatz is glad to meet someone who will not eat him. Mebok Mizzyrix, a goblin from Ratchet, needs bogbean leaves for a potion. Ignatz says the reason does not matter; the pay was good, and he knows the swamp. But before he found the plant, critters surrounded him. He asks you to help him escape and guard him while he searches.

sections.title: Word From Mebok
sections.body: Mebok says Ignatz returned with the herbs and told him how you helped. A friend of Stinky's is a friend of his. Before Ignatz headed south to the marsh again, he asked Mebok to give you something if you ever met.

faq.answer: “Stinky” Ignatz is searching the swamp for bogbean leaves for Mebok Mizzyrix. He says he knows the swamp, yet critters surrounded him before he found the plant.

faq.q: Why is Ignatz gathering bogbean leaves?
faq.answer: Mebok Mizzyrix, a goblin from Ratchet, needs bogbean leaves for a potion. Ignatz says the reason does not matter; the pay was good.
Mebok Mizzyrix is a goblin from Ratchet who needs bogbean leaves to brew a potion.

faq.q: Who should you speak to afterward?
aliases: where to turn in stinkys escape
faq.answer: After helping Ignatz, find Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
